status: Proposed project-controlled vocabulary, not a claimed universal standard.

kinds.definition: Reusable computational artifact: application, library, framework, CLI, harness, plugin or skill package.
A hosted or human-delivered service with a reusable function or offering.
A named learned model or model family/version, distinct from a service exposing it.
A defined reusable data collection, benchmark dataset or corpus.
A published specification, protocol or explicitly identified de facto convention; status and authority are evidence fields.
A reusable method, technique, workflow or pattern rather than its particular implementation.
A paper, article, report, book or other work that is itself the subject of the query.
A course, tutorial collection, curriculum or other learning resource.
A non-software tangible product or product system.
An institution or community that is itself a relevant resource, not merely a source owner.
A justified item not yet represented; requires a proposed label and no invented certainty.

rules: One stable entity can have many facets; a skill and a harness are delivery forms, not arbitrary top-level domains.
Evidence source type and entity kind are separate. A Reddit thread about a tool is normally evidence for software, not a second software entity.
Choose the primary kind from what the entity is; relationships cover implementations, versions, alternatives and standards conformance.
Uncertain classification is explicit and reviewable; do not select a type to gain score.
Identifiers survive renames/retyping; preserve aliases and original references.
